# Airwallex AgentOS

`GRADED` `PROPOSES-WRITES` `HUMAN-APPROVAL`

Airwallex's own Claude plugin (beta): creates invoices and subscriptions from contracts, sets up supplier beneficiaries from invoices, issues corporate cards, and reports multi-currency cash and FX exposure. It cannot send transfers or convert currency; those stay in the Airwallex dashboard.

**What it can do:** Changes records only after you approve.

## Why these badges

- **`PROPOSES-WRITES`** — Creates invoices, subscriptions, beneficiaries, cardholders and cards. Transfers, payouts and FX conversions are refused: "I can't execute ... through this tool — that needs to be done in the Airwallex Dashboard."
- **`HUMAN-APPROVAL`** — Defaults to sandbox; "Show the full payload to the user and get confirmation before every write", and confirms the environment before any production write.
